capabilities: Preview numeric citation groups on hover
Expand ranges and drop repeated numbers
Flag missing entries and duplicate numbers
Recognize plain bracketed numbers without links
Cap group size and require a modifier key
disambiguation: Not a citation manager or formatter; it only previews numeric citations against a bibliography already in the same note.
extras: Relies on Obsidian's private embed registry and renderer, so app updates may affect compatibility; requires Obsidian 1.15.1 or later, is installed manually, and is designed for desktop mouse hover with no touch gesture.
intentEvidence: Existing plugins address different workflows. ZotLit draws on a Zotero library, and Citation Suite resolves Pandoc citation keys
motivation: Built so readers can preview a numeric citation group from the bibliography already in the current note, keeping each reference maintained once.
problem: Obsidian link previews target a single block, so previewing a citation group whose references sit in separate blocks would require duplicating them into a dedicated block.

relations.evidence: ZotLit draws on a Zotero library
Citation Suite resolves Pandoc citation keys using Zotero or a separate .bib or CSL JSON file
Inline Annotations displays notes attached to selected text

summary: Hover-preview tool that shows the numbered bibliography entries for a numeric citation group such as [1, 3, 5] from the same note.
